name: Blood & healing

overlay.caption: cut → platelets stick → a mesh plugs the leak → scab guards new skin

does: Shows bleeding slowing and stopping as a clot builds over minutes
Shows a bigger scrape taking longer to plug
Shows clot strength rising as bleeding falls
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Show the days-long regrowth of skin under the scab
Cover deep cuts or anything that needs an adult's help
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: A cut that keeps bleeding after you press on it for a few minutes is a reason to get an adult.
